[RDSC.14.4.3] `target` identifies the documented node; `schema_name` /
`slot_name` / `rule_name` carry its identity per target kind; `text` is the
UTF-8 docstring. The source location is carried **inline** as `ds_line` /
`ds_col`, **not** as a reference to a `LineSpan` atom: `LineSpan` atoms exist only for
beta / terminal (rule) nodes ([RDSC.14.3.6]), so schema and slot targets have
no `LineSpan` to reference — inline coordinates keep every `DocString` atom self-contained
for tooling. The compiler emits `DocString` for **schema, slot, and rule** targets;
`DOC_TARGET_MODULE` is **reserved**.
